name: wuzpay
description: Point of Sale System for University Project

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,OCR" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ocr"
scripts.dev:ocr: node -e "const exec = require('child_process').execSync; const py = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'ocr\\Scripts\\python.exe' : './ocr/bin/python'; exec('cd backend/ocr-service && ' + py + ' main.py', {stdio: 'inherit'})"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && cd backend/ocr-service && node -e "const exec = require('child_process').execSync; try { exec('python -m venv ocr'); } catch { exec('python3 -m venv ocr'); }" && node -e "const exec = require('child_process').execSync; const pip = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'ocr\\Scripts\\pip.exe' : './ocr/bin/pip'; exec('cd backend/ocr-service && ' + pip + ' install -r requirements.txt', {stdio: 'inherit'})"
